decisions.reason: The CO2-negative bitumen binder sits furthest from the core machinery business, but management presented it as a flagship of its circular-materials direction and has sunk development effort into it, so it will likely attribute slow uptake to early-market conditions and persist for now.
WASTX Cleanic is a publicly announced flagship co-developed with ERMAFA and close to core competencies, so partner commitment and sunk co-development costs make continuation likely.
The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant is central to the decentralized modular WASTX strategy the firm has announced, making withdrawal very unlikely.
